route_definitions.before: frozen pre-change F06; only the 36 affected large activation cases

protocol.e2e: 31 independent host timings: synchronize before start; one ordinary call; synchronize before stop; median
protocol.host_batch: 7 groups of 400 ordinary calls, synchronized at boundaries; median average call time
protocol.gpu: same external CUDA Graph protocol for every route; 64 calls per graph except 8 for M=2048 MatMul; 7 groups of 20 replays; CUDA Events
protocol.shape_scope: fixed shapes, repeated fixed device input addresses, warm cache
protocol.isolation: one process per route per round; reset only between cases; reverse route and case order in round B
